name: Micronaut Core 5.2.17
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Ignore a Range request when the If-Range validator does not match by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14020
* Map the non-sealed modifier and skip unknown modifiers in Java elements by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13996
* Answer 400 for a StreamingFileUpload without a form body by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13868
### Improvements ⭐
* Python: warn about function-local classes GraalPy adapts to a Java type by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13832
### Other Changes 💡
* Python: restore the Extending Java Classes guide page by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13931
* Describe @ReadableBytes configuration properties as byte sizes in JSON schemas by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13827
* Let a client filter add a cookie to a raw request by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13435
* Reuse the bootstrap context across environment refreshes by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13988


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.16...v5.2.17
